cues.t: Well, it turns out that there's two kinds of procrastination.

cues.t: But there's a second kind of procrastination
cues.r: 但还有第二种拖延，

cues.t: that happens in situations when there is no deadline.

cues.t: to get momentum, get things going.

And it's this long-term kind of procrastination
